learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.evidence: Selected10cm for two identical end-to-end springs when one stretches5cm under1kg.
One spring5cm/9.81N; side by side2.5cm/4.91N each; end to end10cm/9.81N each. Both comparisons required before reveal.
Full weight through the chain means each stretches5cm and stretches add; parallel shares weight. Pair half versus twice as stiff. Identical weightless springs within elastic range stated.
Inspected actual1257x936 dark viewport showing two series springs,9.81N labels on both,10cm bracket and readable full reveal after scroll.
